Cozy home meal
Jan 2024 • Friends
I was introduced to Tai Ngon Kitchen by friends, very surprised with the cozy space here and the warmth of the host. You could hardly find a home meal on your trip as well as it is difficult to understand the local culture when you just sit in a closed restaurant with all the services pre-scripted, but at Tai Ngon Kitchen I have found many touched moment with 4 unique dishes and many improvised stories. 

The kitchen is located in an apartment complex, the local people living around there welcome me as home sweet home. 

I definitely come back here again and again, never forget invite my friends because of the warm energy and these incredibly caring dishes deserve to spread.

A must-do experience if you want to understand Ho Chi Minh more deeply.
Nov 2023 • Solo
It was one of my best experiences at hcm. Exceeded all my expectations. Even I forgot to take pictures of the food so I could enjoy this evening and find out when dinner was over.
Host Richard was very friendly. Also the food was very good. We had 5 dishes made with various ingredients including pork, chicken, poultry, and beef. All the food was delicious and the portions were generous.
Over the course of two hours, our talk covered so many topics, from food, culture, and even each other's businesses(?!). I found out more about it here on hcm.

If you want a real local experience in hcm you should try this home dining as well as the night tour bus. It is worth more than 100 times more. I guarantee it

Have to say, the decor is outstanding (the chef do the house decor by himself OMG), the local food is above acceptable with amazing story behind.
